label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (S100A8/A9 inflammatory signal)
description: Cluster leans toward differentiated squamous epithelial (likely tumor) cells. The clearest support is M69 (CRNN, KLK13, KRT23, CNFN), M65 (KRT13, KRT4, PPL, SCEL, EVPL) and M28 (PI3, KRT24, TGM1, IVL, CLCA4), with the top genes CRNN, KLK13, CLCA4, PI3 and KRT24 all strongly enriched. Basal markers are absent, so the cells look superficial rather than basal. S100A8/S100A9 (about 2-3% of counts) reflects a modest neutrophil or inflammatory component, below the contamination threshold, and diffuse stress genes (M61, M21) add background.
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Glandular secretory epithelium program
initial_label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (S100A8/A9 inflammatory signal)
refine_reason: Standardize the squamous identity wording to 'Differentiated squamous epithelium', as used in clusters 3 and 30, keeping the S100A8/A9 contamination note.

label: Low-quality cells, no clear lineage
description: Cluster 1 is dominated by technical or diffuse factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 14.9% share) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4, 11.7%), which are multi-copy or probe-like artifacts with no lineage theme. No strong lineage is present. Weak squamous signal appears in M37 (keratinization genes FLG, CRNN, IVL, 1.6%) and M10 (KRT15, ITGA2, DSC3, 1.5%), and a minor myeloid component in M14 (CLEC10A, FCGR2A, 1.9%, found in only 7% of cells). Together these are too weak to define an identity, so the cluster is probably low quality.
cell_types: Low-quality cells (no clear lineage), Squamous epithelium (weak)

label: Regulatory T cells (CD3+ T cell cluster)
description: Cluster 2 is a T-lymphocyte population, with the T-cell core (M29: CD3E, CD3D, TRAC, TRBC2, CD2, CD247, BCL11B) and a strong regulatory T-cell factor (M83: FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT) among its enriched metagenes and top genes (TRAC, CD3E, TRBC1, CTLA4, FOXP3-linked signal). The Treg signature is substantial in about 41% of cells, so the cluster leans toward regulatory T cells within a broader T-cell identity. A cytotoxic CD8/NK metagene (M93) appears in about 24% of cells with a 5% share, a minor add-on rather than a separate population. Remaining metagenes (M8, M13, M89, M60, M64, M58, M94, M2) are diffuse nuclear/RNA-processing or baseline background with no lineage. M79 and M9 carry weak interferon/lymphocyte signal, and M75 is a weak stromal stress add-on; none indicates a meaningful foreign lineage.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells
metagene_label: T cell markers + Regulatory T cell markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (+ hypoxic, inflamed)
description: Cluster 3 is a differentiated squamous epithelial population from the cervical tumor. M37 (18.8% share, in 56% of cells, 79x enriched) carries the cornification and granular-layer genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL and KRT13, and M15 adds terminal differentiation genes (IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK10). M69 (CRNN-high) and M18 support the same lineage. Top genes ERO1A, CRNN, IVL, FLG, CRCT1 and SCEL agree. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so the cells look superficial rather than basal. Hypoxia (M11) and neutrophil-like S100A8/S100A9 signal (M0, M70) are present as add-ons, with S100A8/A9 likely from neutrophil or myeloid infiltration and not a separate lineage.

label: Fibroblast ECM + smooth muscle stroma (low signal)
description: Cluster 4 is weakly stromal. The cell-type signal is modest: a fibroblast ECM factor (M4, 4.1% share, fold 1.8x, in 15% of cells) and a smooth muscle/myofibroblast factor (M19, 4.0%, fold 2.6x, in 10% of cells), with a small stromal-state add-on (M75, 2.3%). Most of the modeled counts come from diffuse, low-specificity background factors (M64, M58, M43, M95) built from housekeeping genes such as GNAS, NPM1, PTMA and TPT1. The top genes (SFRP4, CCN2) are consistent with stroma, but the enrichment is weak, so the cluster's identity is uncertain and it may be a low-signal or low-quality stromal cluster. No immune or epithelial lineage is evident.

label: B cells (germinal center/follicular subset)
description: Cluster 5 is dominated by a clean B-cell program (M34, 16.5% share, present in 81% of cells, fold 84x) with MS4A1, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, CD22, TNFRSF13C, POU2AF1 and IRF8 among the top genes. A germinal-center/follicular B add-on (M33, fold 72x, CXCL13, CR2, GCSAM, AICDA, FCER2, in 13% of cells) suggests a subset within lymphoid aggregates. The remaining metagenes (M79, M8, M13, M9, M2, M60, M89, M64, M58) are diffuse, low-specificity background with no lineage, and M14 myeloid and M75 stromal signals are small (about 2% each), so they are not treated as contamination.
cell_types: B cells, Germinal center B cells

label: Squamous epithelial cells (+ S100A8/A9 myeloid signal)
description: Cluster 6 is squamous epithelial, likely tumor or differentiated cervical epithelium. The top genes are squamous differentiation and desmosomal genes (KRT13, DSP, PERP, DSG3, DSC2, DSC3, SERPINB13, KRT24, KLK10), with KRT5 and CD24 present. Support comes from M5, M6 and M0, while M1 and M26 add a basal keratinocyte component. M0 and the top genes S100A8/S100A9 carry a myeloid-like inflammatory signal, but it is broadly present and not clearly from a separate population, so it is treated as moderate spillover or contamination rather than a doublet lineage. M12, M55, M46, M67 and M40 are diffuse, low-specificity background.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Cervical tumor cells
contaminants: myeloid (S100A8/S100A9 signal, likely neutrophil or spillover)
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Squamous epithelium, KRT13/DSP-high

label: Fibroblasts (activated, ECM-high)
description: Cluster 7 is a fibroblast-dominated stromal cluster. The main signal is the fibroblast ECM factor M4 (18.5% share, in ~70% of cells, 40x fold), supported by top genes COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, LUM, TNC, AEBP1 and THY1. Activated/cancer-associated fibroblast factor M38 (6.1%) and smooth-muscle/myofibroblast factor M19 (13.8%, in ~38% of cells, with DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN, GREM1 among top genes) add to a stromal identity with some perivascular/smooth-muscle-like character; pericyte factor M25 is minor. The remaining metagenes (M56, M95, M60, M63, M84, M64, M62, M90, M92) are diffuse housekeeping or background factors with no lineage, and M75 is a minor stromal stress add-on. No immune or epithelial contamination is evident.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Cancer-associated fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Endothelial cells (+ pericyte-like signal)
description: Cluster 8 is dominated by endothelial identity: M27 (Endothelial cells, 22.2% share, present in 66% of cells, >100x enrichment) with canonical vascular genes VWF, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, PECAM1, KDR, MMRN1 among top genes. M25 (pericyte-like NOTCH3/RGS5, 18.1% share, 72% of cells) is a strong co-signal, consistent with vessel-associated mural cells that are often captured together with endothelium in spatial bins, and may reflect a stress/activation state. Fibroblast ECM (M4) and activated fibroblast (M38) are minor (under 3%), and remaining metagenes are diffuse low-usage background, so no major foreign lineage is present.

label: Low-quality technical cluster (weak stromal signal)
description: Cluster 9 has no coherent lineage. Its composition is dominated by technical or artifact-like factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 13.1% share, in 25% of cells, probe or multi-mapping artifact with a weak keratin tail), M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA multi-copy families, 10.4%), and several diffuse nuclear RNA-processing factors (M45, M60, M8, M56, M95, M22, M85) totalling a few percent each. The top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SIGLEC15, SMG1, PDE4DIP, multi-copy USP17L/GOLGA6L4/KRBOX4 genes) confirm this. Minor identity signals are present but weak: fibroblast ECM (M4, 3.2%), smooth muscle/myofibroblast (M19, 2.6%) and endothelial (M27, 1.3%), each in only a few percent of cells. No lineage carries enough share to define the cluster, so it is best treated as a low-quality cluster with a diffuse stromal hint.

label: Diffuse low-specificity background cells (ambiguous)
description: Cluster 10 has no lineage signal. Its modeled counts are spread across many diffuse, low-specificity metagenes (M45, M2, M56, M22, M60, M89, M8, M99, M85), all with mostly nuclear, RNA-processing or multi-copy genes (SMG1, IST1, ITCH, OR4F17, SIGLEC15, GOLGA family), and the top genes are the same. The technical-looking OR4F17/IST1-high M30 carries 9.0% share and is enriched 12.5x here. A weak basal squamous epithelial component is present (M74 COL7A1/TP63/ITGB4 at 3.7% in 5.3% of cells, M10 KRT15 at 2.1%), but it is too small and scattered to define the cluster. The cluster looks like a low-quality or background population, so it is called ambiguous rather than a cell type.

label: T lymphocytes (+ stromal signal)
description: Cluster leans toward mature T lymphocytes: M29 (T cell markers, fold 2.9x) and the top genes TRAC, CD3E, GIMAP7, GIMAP4, CD52 and ETS1 support this, with Treg (M83, FOXP3/CTLA4/IL2RA) and cytotoxic CD8 (M93, CD8A/GZMK/CST7) add-ons. Stromal signal is present in most cells at moderate level: fibroblast ECM (M4, COL3A1/SFRP4/LUM) and smooth muscle/myofibroblast (M19, DES/MYH11/TAGLN, CCN2), together about 8% of counts, which is contamination or a stromal admixture rather than the cluster's own identity. Technical metagenes (M30 OR4F17, M2, M8) dominate the rest of the counts and carry no identity.
cell_types: T cells, Regulatory T cells, CD8 T cells

label: Squamous epithelium + technical signal (low confidence)
description: Small cluster (279 cells) dominated by technical and diffuse metagenes: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, multi-copy and cancer-testis genes, 12.7%) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA family, 9.8%) make up over a fifth of counts with no coherent lineage. The only lineage signal is a weak squamous/keratinocyte component (M0 with KRT13, KRT4, CD24, PERP, DSC2 at 7.0%, M5 KRT5/DSP/KRT13 at 3.1%, M15 cornification genes IVL/SBSN/KLK10 at 1.3%), consistent with squamous epithelial or tumor cells in cervical cancer. Inflammatory NF-kB/TNF and IFN-gamma programs (M36, M35, M49) are present at low share and do not define an identity. Top genes IVL, TNFAIP2, CXCL8, IL1A and PPP1R15A support a differentiated squamous epithelial cell with an inflammatory state, but the call is weak.

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (hypoxic)
description: Small cluster of squamous epithelial cells. M6 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes, 25% of counts, 10x enriched) and the basal-like factors M26 and M80 carry most of the signal, and the top genes SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2, NECTIN4, CTNND1 and MUC4 support a differentiated squamous identity with a hypoxia/stress component. M20 (glandular secretory) and M45 (diffuse, ambiguous) are minor and do not change the call. No clear foreign lineage is present.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Basal keratinocytes, Tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes + Basal keratinocyte program
refine_reason: Align the identity wording with 'Differentiated squamous epithelium' used elsewhere, keeping the hypoxic qualifier.

label: Fibroblasts (technical-heavy, weak signal)
description: Small cluster (45 cells) whose enriched genes are fibroblast ECM and stromal genes: COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, LUM, TNC, DKK3 at 4-5x over other cells, carried mainly by M4 (fibroblast ECM, 5.1x fold), with activated-stroma M38 and smooth-muscle-like M19 as add-ons. Technical metagenes (M30 OR4F17/IST1, M2 multi-copy genes, M56, M22) take a large share and dilute the call, so confidence is limited. Minor plasma-cell IGHG1 signal (M3, 2.6x) is small and not treated as contamination.

label: Fibroblasts (weak, diffuse signal)
description: Cluster 15 is a small group of 36 cells with no dominant lineage. The only lineage with a clear program is fibroblast ECM (M4, 7.0% share, fold 3.1), supported by COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1 and COL6A1 among the top genes. Smooth muscle/myofibroblast (M19), endothelial (M27) and Treg (M83) metagenes are each 3-4% and present in only 3-6% of cells, so they are minor background rather than contamination. Most of the top genes (NPM1, IFNGR1, STT3B, MBD2, DDX3X) are diffuse housekeeping or ER-secretory signal, so the identity is weak.
metagene_label: ER protein translocation and glycosylation + NPM1/SMC1A/MED14-high

label: Basal squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 16 is a basal/reserve squamous epithelial population. Its top genes are KRT15, TP63, ITGB4, ITGA2, LAMB3 and ITGA6, and the leading metagenes are M1 (basal squamous epithelial, 9.1% share, fold 5.0x), M26 (basal keratinocyte program, fold 5.3x), M10 (KRT15-high basal-like, fold 8.3x) and M80 (basal squamous state, fold 11.4x). KRT14 and KRT5 are only partly captured, and the profile is diffuse, so the call rests on the basal marker set rather than a sharp signature. Proliferation (M17) and NF-kB (M36) are minor, and no clear foreign lineage contamination is present.
cell_types: Basal squamous epithelial cells, Basal-like tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Basal squamous epithelial cells + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Glandular epithelial cells with fibroblast signal (mixed)
description: Small, low-confidence cluster of 24 cells with no dominant lineage. The most enriched signal is glandular/mucosal epithelial: M20 (MUC1, CEACAM7, LYPD2, TMPRSS2, PSCA; 7.7x fold), with M54 (mucinous/stress tumor epithelium) and M51 (TMPRSS2/PRSS22) supporting it, and top genes MUC1, TMPRSS2, LYPD2, CEACAM7 and PRSS22 are all 3-6x enriched. Fibroblast signal is comparable in share (M4 ECM, M38 activated stroma; COL3A1, COL6A1, COL6A2, COL5A1 at about 3x) and probably reflects stromal spillover or a mixed doublet-like population, since fibroblast metagene M4 peaks in cluster 33. Endothelial, B-cell and squamous signals are small and minor. OR4F17 and the diffuse metagenes (M2, M30, M68) are technical and carry no identity.
metagene_label: Glandular secretory epithelium program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Cycling cells (proliferating, lineage unclear)
description: Proliferating cluster in cervical cancer section dominated by cell-cycle programs: M7 (histone and mitotic core, 8.5% share, 9.9x), M17 (S-phase DNA replication, 7.3%), M24 (G1/S replication) and M39 (G2/M proliferation, 4.9x) together account for most counts, with top genes H1-5, H3C2, TPX2, MKI67, TOP2A, RRM2, CENPF and BIRC5 all strongly enriched. No lineage metagene is strong: squamous/basal signals (M1, M5, M74) are modest and diffuse, and M22, M16 and M12 are ambiguous baseline factors. Identity is therefore a proliferating population of uncertain lineage, most plausibly cycling tumor cells, with only weak squamous epithelial signal.
cell_types: Cycling tumor cells, Cycling squamous epithelial cells
metagene_label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic genes + S-phase DNA replication program

label: Regulatory T cells (T cell lineage, diffuse background)
description: Cluster 19 is a small T-lymphocyte population. The largest lineage signal is M83 (Regulatory T cell markers: FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT; 7.2% share, in 38% of cells, 6.4x fold), supported by M29 (T cell core: CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, BCL11B) and M93 (CD8/cytotoxic: CD8A, GZMK, EOMES). Top genes CTLA4, TRAC, CD3E, TRBC1, TRBC2 and ETS1 agree, so the cluster leans toward Tregs within a T-cell background. Most of the remaining mass is diffuse technical or ambiguous signal (OR4F17, IST1, SIGLEC15 metagenes M30, M2, M8), which I did not treat as lineage. No significant foreign lineage contamination is evident.

label: Tumor-associated macrophages (myeloid)
description: Myeloid cluster dominated by M14 (22.1% of counts, in 80% of cells), with CLEC10A, FCGR2A, FGL2, CSF1R and LYZ, and by M59 (7.8%, in 38% of cells), a tumor-associated macrophage program with C1QA/C1QC, APOE, SPP1, MMP9, CD163 and CD14. Top genes (C1QA, C1QC, MMP9, APOE, CD14, CSF1R, STAB1, FCER1G) are all myeloid and strongly enriched, so the cluster is myeloid, leaning toward macrophages, with a CLEC10A/FCGR2A-high dendritic-like or monocyte-like component in most cells. Remaining metagenes (M8, M9, M77, M1, M71, M99, M49, M64, M68) are diffuse with shares under 3%, so they are background and not contamination.

label: Fibroblasts (IFN-gamma response)
description: Small cluster (34 cells) whose identity leans toward fibroblasts/stroma: M4 (fibroblast ECM, 6.5%) and M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, 5.1%) carry collagens COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, SFRP4 and COL4A1 among the top genes. The largest signal, M49 (IFN-gamma response, 8.7%, fold 16x), is driven by CXCL10, CXCL9, STAT1, TAP1, GBP1 and IDO1, a program shared across lineages, so it qualifies the state rather than the identity. M27 endothelial (6.0%, in only ~2 cells, with VWF in the top genes) and M93 CD8/NK cytotoxic (3.7%, in ~12% of cells) look like minor foreign signal, probably doublets or spillover.
contaminants: Endothelial cells, CD8 cytotoxic T/NK cells
metagene_label: IFN-gamma response program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed, cycling subset)
description: Small, low-confidence cluster. Its most informative signal is squamous differentiation: M37 (fold 9.2, present in 13.9% of cells) with CRNN, ECM1 and CTNND1 among the top genes, plus M0 (differentiated squamous epithelium with S100A8/A9). M17 (S-phase program, 7.5%) suggests some cycling. Most of the modeled counts sit in diffuse ambiguous factors (M45, M64, M84), which carry no lineage. A small macrophage signal (M59, 3.1%, fold 5.0, in 8.3% of cells) is minor and not clearly contamination.

label: Fibroblasts (+ diffuse background)
description: Small cluster (40 cells) whose best-supported identity is fibroblast, from the fibroblast ECM factor M4 (10.1% share, present in 10% of cells, 4.5x enriched) and the activated ECM factor M38, with top genes COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1 and COL6A1. About a third of counts come from diffuse housekeeping factors (M58, M64, M86, M91, M89, M85) with no lineage theme, so the call is weak. Plasma-cell (M3, IGHG1 as the top gene, 2.1%) and T-cell (M29, 3.8%) signals are small background. M59 macrophage signal (7.3%) sits in only about one cell and is largest in cluster 20, so it is probably spillover.
contaminants: Tumor-associated macrophages (minor spillover), Plasma cells (minor), T cells (minor)

label: Fibroblasts (weak, with T cell signal)
description: Small cluster (39 cells) with weak, diffuse signal. The most enriched identity signal is the fibroblast ECM metagene M4 (11.2% share, 5.0x fold), supported by top genes COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, COL6A1, TNC, COL5A1 and IGF1, so the cluster leans toward fibroblasts. Roughly 10% of counts come from lymphoid metagenes M93 (CD8 cytotoxic T/NK, CD8A, CST7) and M29 (T cell markers), which are present in only a few cells and look like spillover or doublets. Most of the remaining counts sit in diffuse background metagenes (M58, M40, M94, M95, M46, M43), which carry no lineage.

label: IgG plasma cells (ER stress high)
description: Antibody-secreting plasma cells, mainly IgG-class. M3 (IgG plasma cell markers, IGHG1, IGKC, XBP1, MZB1, DERL3, PRDM1) carries 14.1% of counts, M31 (plasma immunoglobulin program, IGHG3, IGHA1, IGLC7, JCHAIN) 5.8%, and M23 (IGHG2-dominated, MZB1, DERL3) 1.8%. Top genes IGHG1, IGHG2, IGKC, IGHG3, IGLC7, MZB1, XBP1, DERL3 and POU2AF1 agree. M53, an ER stress/UPR program (HERPUD1, SEC11C, ERN1, DNAJC3), makes up 24.9% of counts in most cells and qualifies the plasma-cell state. B-cell (MS4A1, CD19) and T-cell (CD3E) markers are absent. Fibroblast signal (M4, 3.1%, in 11% of cells) is minor and not treated as contamination.
metagene_label: ER stress unfolded protein response + IgG plasma cell markers

label: Smooth muscle-like stromal cells (+ T cell signal)
description: Small cluster (35 cells) dominated by stromal signal: smooth muscle/myofibroblast metagene M19 (13.9%, fold 9.2x) with activated fibroblast ECM metagenes M38 and M4 (combined ~11.5%), supported by top genes TAGLN, MYLK, CCN2, SFRP4, COL3A1, COL6A1, COL5A1, GREM1. Lineage is stromal rather than epithelial, though it is a minority of cells for each stromal factor. Smaller T-cell signal (M29, 7.4%, fold 6.6x, in ~6% of cells) suggests some T-lymphocyte contamination or a rare doublet subset. Remaining metagenes (M64, M62, M76, M84, M82) are diffuse housekeeping background, and M69/M28 squamous differentiation signals are weak.
cell_types: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast cells, Cancer-associated fibroblasts
metagene_label: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma + T cell markers

label: NF-kB/TNF-responsive cells (lineage unresolved)
description: Small cluster of 50 cells dominated by M36, an NF-kB/TNF inflammatory response program (12.3% of counts, fold 16.1x, top gene TNFAIP2), but this is a state, not an identity. Lineage signals are weak and split: squamous differentiation metagenes M37, M69 and M5 (with CRNN in the top genes, fold 4.5x) total about 9% of counts, while T/cytotoxic CD8 metagenes M29 and M93 total about 6% and are present in only 4-6% of cells. The top genes contain no clear T-cell markers. Lineage is therefore unresolved, with a weak squamous lean and a possible lymphoid component. The remaining metagenes (M45, M12, M99, M58, M91, M85) are diffuse background.

label: Activated fibroblasts (minor plasma cell signal)
description: Cluster 28 (27 cells) is a fibroblast/stromal cluster dominated by the fibroblast ECM core M4 (41% share, 82% of cells) and the activated, ECM-remodeling fibroblast state M38 (21% share, 33% of cells), with top genes COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, SFRP1/4, LUM, TNC, COL1A2 and POSTN/INHBA/MMP11 supporting this. Minor IgG plasma cell signal (M3, M31, 3-4% of cells) and a small squamous/inflamed component (M37, 4.5%) are present, likely spillover or minor contamination rather than a distinct population; myeloid/TAM metagenes (M14, M59) are weak here.
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Activated fibroblasts, ECM-remodeling

label: Fibroblast/squamous epithelial mixture (+ lymphoid signal)
description: Small, low-coherence cluster with two competing signals. Stromal genes are the strongest theme: fibroblast ECM M4 (SFRP1/SFRP4, COL3A1, TNC) and smooth muscle/myofibroblast M19 (DES, MYH11, CCN2, THBS1) together carry about 11% of counts, with stromal state M75 adding a little more. Squamous differentiation M37 (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL) with M70 gives about 10%, and the top genes include FLG and CRNN at high fold. Basal markers and core epithelial genes are absent, so the squamous signal is superficial or differentiated. Lymphoid signal (Treg M83, CD8 cytotoxic M93) is small and confined to a few cells, so it is minor contamination. Most remaining metagenes are diffuse housekeeping factors. The cluster is probably a mixture of stroma and differentiated squamous epithelium, with low confidence.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed)
description: A tiny cluster (32 cells) whose most enriched signal is superficial squamous differentiation. M37 (fold 11.6x, with FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL and KRT13) and M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP) support differentiated keratinocytes, and M0 and M6 add a squamous add-on with S100A8/A9 and hypoxia genes. The largest-share metagenes (M79, M89, M50, M98) are diffuse and unresolved, and basal markers KRT5/KRT14 are absent. Fibroblast ECM signal (M4, 3.5% share, found in about 6% of cells) is minor background. IGHG1 is among the top genes but no plasma metagene supports it, so it is not called.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (+ T cell and fibroblast signal)
description: A small cluster of 30 cells dominated by keratinizing squamous epithelial differentiation: M37 (12.4% share, fold 19, FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL) and M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP) lead, with the top genes ERO1A, CRNN, FLG, IVL and CRCT1. Basal markers KRT5/KRT14 are absent, so this leans toward superficial squamous cells. Foreign signal is moderate: T-cell core genes (M29, 7.2%, CD3E/TRAC/CD2) and fibroblast ECM genes (M4, 6.2%, COL3A1/SFRP4) each sit around 5-10%, and plasma cell IgG genes (M3, IGHG1 in the top genes) are weaker at 1.6%. These likely reflect spillover or doublets with stroma and immune cells rather than a distinct population.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + T cell markers

label: Ambiguous, inflamed squamous epithelial signal (low quality)
description: Small cluster of 33 cells (<0.1%) with no clear lineage. Its metagene composition is dominated by diffuse, low-specificity factors (M45, M50, M58, M56, M64, M2, M57, M98, M89, M86, M91) that look like background or RNA-content signal rather than identity. The most coherent theme is a squamous differentiation/inflamed keratinizing signature (M37: FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, with S100A8 and hypoxia genes ERO1A, HILPDA), present in about 12% of cells, plus an NF-kB inflammatory program (M35: IL1A, CXCL8, PPP1R15A) and a modest T-cell metagene (M29: CD3E, TRAC, BCL11B) at about 4% share. The T-cell signal is too weak to define the cluster and is likely minor contamination or a small subset. Overall the cluster lacks a supported lineage and is best called ambiguous with low confidence.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells (inflamed), Ambiguous low-quality cells

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)
description: Cluster 33 is a small, tight fibroblast population: M4 (fibroblast ECM core: COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1, LUM, PDGFRA) carries 42% of counts in 92% of cells at 19x enrichment, and the top genes (COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, DIO2, LUM, IGF1, COL1A2) confirm it. M38 (activated/cancer-associated fibroblast ECM, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) adds 13% in under half the cells.
